text_block_list.text:
I came to the shrine together with Fine 
Motion, who hasn't been doing well lately.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh... A Japanese power spot...! Now my 
hopes are really up!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Because mysterious things happen at 
shrines, right? Like youkai or divine 
messengers appearing..."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, absolutely! Back in my home country, 
fairies were often spotted in old churches 
and places like that... I've always wanted 
to see one for myself!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Besides, those kinds of mysterious beings 
are said to grant blessings to those who 
see them sometimes! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Maybe, just maybe... it might even cure my 
slump—
(—Drag... slither...)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I heard it from over there! Let's go check 
it out!

I hurriedly chased after Fine Motion, 
running toward the eerie sound...

(Slide, drag... drag... Squeeze, squeeze! 
Squeeeeze! *creak*!!)
Hnnngh~~~~~!! Princess Rope Biiiiind~~~!!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Phew... Oh, good day to both of you!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami-chan! Um, is that... by any 
chance... the sacred rope from the sacred 
tree...?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes♪ It seems to have loosened up, so the 
head priest asked me if I could retie it 
for him!
choice_data_list: I was wondering what that sound was!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look at that~♪ So the fairy was 
Kawakami-chan all along~.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
“Still... that sounds super motivating! 
Hey, can I help out too?”

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Alright then, time to tie 
things up tight!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Heeeeyaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
Well now, thank you very much, all three 
of you. Ho ho ho, God must be pleased as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the gods did...? I am honored to have 
been of service.

Perhaps as a divine favor, Fine Motion's 
condition noticeably improved from that 
day on!

Accompanying Fine Motion, we hurriedly 
pursued the eerie sound, but...
(Slump... *freeze*... *silence*—)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
—Haa, haa... Oh, did the sound suddenly 
stop...? I'm sure I was hearing it just a 
moment ago.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hmm... I've got a bad feeling about this.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fairies and monsters sometimes play pranks 
that go way beyond a simple joke, you 
know...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
We'd be in trouble if anything happened to 
you, Trainer. Let's head back.

They carefully headed back toward the 
shrine. Fine Motion's condition remained 
poor...
